video.title: FULLTANK FRIDAY: Where Is Your Empty Chair?
video.description:
Are you letting your phone, your emails, and the daily noise crowd out your peace before God even gets a single word in? Protect your sacred space, pull up your "empty chair," and simply make room for a real heart-to-heart conversation with Jesus today.

#FULLTANKwithBroBo #FULLTANKwithBroBo2026 #BoSanchez #WhereIsYourEmptyChair #MakeRoomForGod #HouseOfPrayer #FaithInAction #SpiritualMaturity #TrulyRichMindset #DailyPrayer #Grace

---
P.S. Can I personally invite you to something amazing? 
Feast Conference 2026 is happening on this week and it’s our biggest spiritual gathering of the year!
Filled with powerful talks, worship, and community—it’s going to be unforgettable. And I’d love for you to join us! 
Just head over to feastconference.com to be part of this amazing experience.
See you there!

comments.author: @randyvidal1057
comments.text:
Lord Jesus Christ, you open wide the door of your house and you bid us to enter confidently that we may worship you in spirit and truth. Help us to draw near to you with gratitude and joy for your great mercy. May we always revere your word and give you acceptable praise and worship. Amen. But God chose what is foolish in the world to shame the wise; God chose what is weak in the world to shame the strong. 1 Corinthians 1:27, RSV

Lord our God, we come to you poor and yet rich, weak and yet strong, with the prayer that your promise may be fulfilled in Jesus Christ, our dear Lord and Savior. Let the time come when the heavens open and a new light shines over the earth, a time when people will praise and thank you and receive everlasting peace and happiness with you. Remember the many people who come into need these days. Remember our nation and all who work for the good of our country. Bless them and help them. And help the dying, O Lord our God; grant that they come to you, for they are yours. Your help will bring life out of death, joy out of grief and need. May your name be honored, dear Father in Heaven, may your kingdom come and your will be done on earth as in Heaven. In Jesus Christ Name. Amen.
